entries.condition: Composition vs reference_a.png at 1920x1080, positional anchors (1%=10, 2%=9, 4%=8, >6%=fail)

entries.condition: Aircraft outline read against water/island in still_grid and crops/aircraft.png

entries.fix: Add wingtip taper/rounding, 2-3 deg dihedral, thicker root airfoil and rescale the vertical fin to ~35% of wingspan height.

entries.condition: Part connectivity, proportions and thickness in crops/aircraft.png
entries.evidence: Float struts connect to fuselage and floats, water rudders present; but the float spreader bars are single thin lines, the wing has no visible flap/aileron breaks and the engine cowl blends into the cabin without a firewall step.
entries.defect: Missing control-surface breaks and cowl step; strut/spreader geometry is single-segment lines rather than streamlined tubes.

entries.condition: Aircraft span as fraction of frame width vs ref 0.1325 at the same camera altitude

entries.defect: Missing reflections on calm water.
entries.fix: Add planar or SSR reflections of the bridge, islands and skyline blended by Fresnel.

entries.evidence: A small marina with a few static boats sits at H5; no moving boats, wakes, foam lines or shore break anywhere on the bay.
entries.defect: Water has no interaction with anything.
entries.fix: Add moving boats with wakes and a thin foam line along the beaches.

entries.evidence: Dense canopy of rounded blob trees in three green shades covers the island; every tree is the same rounded form, no palms, no understory or grass transitions, and canopy edges are hard against the sand.
entries.defect: Cloned blob canopy with a single tree form at every position.
entries.fix: Add 3-4 tree species including palms, size jitter and a grass/scrub transition to the beach.

entries.evidence: The deck runs continuously to the far shore with two towers and cables; small cars are visible on the deck; cables are single-pixel and aliased; supports are not visible under the deck at this distance.
entries.defect: Cables alias and the low deck shows no piers or shadow line on the water.
entries.fix: Render cables with a minimum screen width and add pier geometry under the deck.

entries.evidence: A grey stratus layer with soft lumps and faint horizontal streaks covers the sky; it reads as overcast but has no visible base undersurface or thickness and streaks look like a stretched noise texture.
entries.defect: Flat painted overcast without volume.
entries.fix: Add a lit underside gradient and low-frequency density variation to the stratus layer.

entries.evidence: Skyline and far shore are desaturated toward the sky grey; mid islands are lighter than the near island; the falloff is slightly fast so the near island looks saturated against already-grey mid islands.
entries.defect: Haze ramp compresses the mid-distance.
entries.fix: Lengthen the haze distance so mid islands keep some saturation.

entries.evidence: Diffuse light with no sun; exposure balanced with readable shadowless canopy and bright wing top; there is no directional cue at all so the canopy looks flat-lit and the water stays bright.
entries.defect: Flat ambient-only lighting.
entries.fix: Add a soft directional term from the brightest sky region and a matching sky-lit water tone.

entries.evidence: No aircraft shadow, no tree-to-tree occlusion and no darkening under the canopy; overcast excuses hard shadows but not the absence of ambient occlusion.
entries.defect: No shadows or occlusion of any kind.
entries.fix: Add SSAO or baked canopy AO and a soft aircraft contact shadow.

entries.evidence: Water has no sky sheen; the airframe shows one faint highlight; floats have a uniform sheen; the wet lagoon sand has no gloss.
entries.defect: Specular is near absent on water and uniform on the aircraft.
entries.fix: Add sky-lit specular to the water and a roughness map on the aircraft.

entries.evidence: Cool grey-blue grading is coherent across sky, haze and skyline; saturated canopy greens and open-water blue break the overcast mood.
entries.defect: Ground and water saturation inconsistent with the sky.
entries.fix: Lower ground/water saturation under the overcast profile.

entries.condition: Temporal stability over the 60-frame clip (metrics.flicker, clip diffs)
entries.evidence: Flicker meanAbsDiff 3.88 (max 15.8) with the f0->f1 pair changing 120k luminance pixels by >40 as the chase camera settles; mid-clip changes are confined to canopy rows 6-8 (parallax plus edge shimmer); clouds and skyline are stable.
entries.defect: Camera settle jump in the first frames and canopy edge shimmer.
entries.fix: Pre-settle the chase camera before capture and enable TAA or MSAA for foliage edges.

entries.evidence: Chase camera keeps the plane centred at x=0.50 through the clip; altitude rises 300->323 m and heading drifts 335->330 with a gentle bank; orientation snaps between f0 and f1 as the follow camera settles.
entries.defect: Initial camera snap.
entries.fix: Warm up the camera smoothing before the first captured frame.

entries.evidence: Forest, beaches, lagoon, a marina, a road loop at G6-H6, causeway, suburbs and a skyline are all present; no traffic on the water, no structures on the near island beyond the loop, no birds or aircraft.
entries.defect: Near island is empty apart from a road loop and the bay is lifeless.
entries.fix: Add scattered houses along the loop, piers, boats and a couple of wakes.

entries.evidence: Near canopy is individual blob trees while the mid island is a flat dark slab with a jagged fringe and the far shore is a low-res strip; the LOD change is visible within the same frame.
entries.defect: Visible LOD step between near canopy and mid-distance islands.
entries.fix: Use an impostor canopy on mid islands that matches the near tree colour and edge frequency.

entries.condition: Repetition (dots_zoom of the horizon right of the skyline)
entries.evidence: A row of about twelve evenly spaced dashes sits just above the horizon at F3-H3; A3-B3 and G3-H3 are uniform grids of identical boxes; the canopy is one cloned tree form.
entries.defect: Evenly spaced objects and cloned trees/buildings.
entries.fix: Jitter placement and vary the far-district models; introduce tree variants.

entries.evidence: Faint dashes float above the horizon line right of the skyline with sky visible beneath them; bridge cables alias to dotted lines; the wing decal rectangles read as holes.
entries.defect: Floating geometry above the horizon.
entries.fix: Clamp far-district geometry to the terrain and fix whatever LOD leaves detached fragments.

entries.evidence: Still HUD reads 121 kt / 984 ft / hdg 335 and matches telemetry (62.4 m/s, 300 m, 335); through the clip the HUD stays at those values while telemetry moves to 58.5 m/s (114 kt), 323 m (1061 ft), heading 330.
entries.defect: HUD frozen in clip.
entries.fix: Update HUD text every frame from live telemetry.

entries.evidence: 60 frames: f0 24.8 ms, median 10.2 ms, p95 35.5 ms, max 54.2 ms at frame 11; the first 20 frames run 13-54 ms before settling to 8-10 ms; 3.66 M triangles, 842 calls, heap flat at 213 MB.
entries.defect: 20-frame slow start and a 54 ms hitch.
entries.fix: Precompile shaders and stream the island geometry before capture.

best3: Overcast haze and desaturated skyline (A2-H3)

entries.condition: Night chase framing (no objective.json for this view)
entries.evidence: Horizon at 0.245 with the lit skyline centred at (0.53-0.62, 0.24-0.29), islands at B4-D5 and the container port at G4-H4; the aircraft centroid (0.50,0.65) spans x 0.25-0.75 so half the frame width is airframe over empty water.
entries.defect: Aircraft dominates and the lower 40 % of the frame is featureless water.
entries.fix: Lower the chase camera pitch or pull back so the islands and skyline fill more of the frame around the aircraft.

entries.evidence: High-wing floatplane with twin floats, struts and yellow-tipped tailplane reads correctly; the wing is a constant-chord slab, the fin is a sliver and the fuselage ends in a sharp cone.
entries.defect: Slab wing and near-invisible fin.
entries.fix: Add wing taper/dihedral and thicken the fin and rudder.

entries.condition: Part connectivity and modelled detail (crops/aircraft.png, wingtips crop)
entries.evidence: Struts meet their attachment points; red and green navigation lights sit on the wingtips; the two dark wing rectangles are flat decals and the cabin roof is a raised grey box; no beacon or strobe.
entries.defect: Decal hatches, boxy cabin roof and no anti-collision beacon at night.
entries.fix: Model hatches as inset geometry and add a rotating red beacon and white strobes.

entries.condition: Aircraft size versus container port, cruise ship and boat
entries.evidence: The cruise ship in crops/medium.png is ~0.03 frame width at ~2 km and the small boat is ~10 px, consistent with a 15 m span aircraft at 40 m spanning 0.50 frame width.
entries.defect: No measurable scale error.
entries.fix: None required beyond keeping tree scale in check.

entries.evidence: Airframe is an evenly lit light grey with panel lines and no specular or Fresnel; floats are a uniform dark navy; cheat lines are flat colour; navigation lights are simple dots without glow.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness across the whole airframe.
entries.fix: Add a roughness map and a clearcoat, and give the nav lights a bloom halo.

entries.evidence: No windows read from behind; there is no cabin or instrument glow at night, only the opaque grey cabin roof.
entries.defect: Glazing absent and no interior light.
entries.fix: Add transparent cabin windows with a faint interior glow.

entries.condition: Lit skyline and shore buildings (crops/distant.png, skyline_lights crop)
entries.evidence: Towers of varied height carry dense random white/cyan window pixels and a few lit crowns, which reads as a city at night; low-rise districts are sprinkled with identical dots, windows have no floor structure and the harbor warehouses are unlit day-shaded boxes.
entries.defect: Window lights are single-pixel noise with no floor rows, and secondary buildings are unlit.
entries.fix: Use window textures with emissive floor rows and add sparse lighting to low-rise and port buildings.

entries.evidence: Islands are flat dark canopy slabs with a constant bright sand rim; the port shoreline is a straight concrete strip; no relief anywhere.
entries.defect: No terrain relief and uniform beach rims.
entries.fix: Add height variation and vary beach width by exposure.

entries.evidence: Water is a bright teal-blue with dark blotches that reads as dusk rather than night; broad diagonal darker bands cross F5-H7 and A4-C8 with no matching cloud above them.
entries.defect: Water too bright for the time of day and unexplained dark bands.
entries.fix: Darken the water albedo from the night sky and fix the cloud-shadow projection scale.

entries.condition: Reflections of the lit skyline and aircraft on calm water
entries.evidence: The calm water directly below the lit skyline shows no light streaks or mirrored towers, no moon glitter and no aircraft reflection.
entries.defect: Missing reflections of the city lights on a calm night surface.
entries.fix: Add planar/SSR reflections with emissive contribution and a moon specular lobe.

entries.evidence: One static small boat in crops/medium.png and a docked cruise ship; no wakes, no boat lights, no moving traffic.
entries.defect: Lifeless water surface.
entries.fix: Add lit moving boats with wakes and a lit cruise ship.

entries.evidence: Islands are covered with the same rounded blob tree at every position, dark green with a hard edge to the sand; no palms or size variation.
entries.defect: Cloned blob canopy.
entries.fix: Add tree species variety, size jitter and a scrub transition.

entries.evidence: A suspension bridge crosses to the port with two towers; its cables render as scattered dots rather than lines and the deck has no lighting; port cranes are recognisable and containers stack plausibly.
entries.defect: Cables alias to dots and the bridge is unlit at night.
entries.fix: Give cables a minimum screen width and add deck and tower lights.

entries.condition: Cloud volume and lighting at night (sky_clouds crop)
entries.evidence: A few small cumulus puffs with soft edges sit in the star field; they are rendered day-white with bright tops rather than moonlit grey and show no volumetric shading.
entries.defect: Day-lit clouds in a night sky.
entries.fix: Drive cloud lighting from the moon/sky colour and darken cloud albedo at night.

entries.evidence: The skyline softens slightly with distance and a lighter band sits at the horizon; far suburbs collapse into a grey noise band above the city.
entries.defect: Far suburbs read as noise.
entries.fix: Fade far low-rise detail into the horizon haze instead of rendering it as speckle.

entries.evidence: The scene reads as blue hour: the airframe top and beaches are bright, the container stacks in G4-H4 are saturated red/blue as if daylit, the clouds are white, while the city relies on emissive windows.
entries.defect: Mixed day and night lighting within one frame.
entries.fix: Use one night lighting rig (moon key + sky fill) for all geometry and rely on emissives for the city.

entries.evidence: No aircraft shadow, no occlusion under the canopy, and diagonal dark bands on the water that do not match the small clouds overhead.
entries.defect: Missing shadows and a mis-scaled shadow band.
entries.fix: Add AO and correct the cloud-shadow projection.

entries.evidence: No glitter or moon highlight on the water, no bloom from window lights, no specular on the airframe or floats.
entries.defect: Specular absent everywhere.
entries.fix: Add a moon specular lobe on the water and bloom for emissives.

entries.evidence: Cool blue night grade is coherent across sky, water and islands; saturated container colours and white clouds break it.
entries.defect: Grading not applied uniformly to day-textured assets.
entries.fix: Grade in a single post pass and lower asset saturation at night.

entries.condition: Temporal stability (metrics.flicker, clip diffs, skyline_f30_32 crop)
entries.evidence: Flicker meanAbsDiff 1.82 (max 8.4) hides severe point shimmer: in the clip's skyline band (y 0.34-0.46, x 0.15-0.85 of the 1280x720 frames) about 3,500 pixels are lit yet 4,700-5,000 pixels cross the 150-luminance threshold between f30-f31, f45-f46 and f58-f59, i.e. the window-dot pattern re-randomises every frame, and bridge cables render as toggling dots.
entries.defect: Point-light and cable shimmer.
entries.fix: Render window lights as emissive texture rows with mip filtering and give cables a minimum width; enable TAA.

entries.evidence: Chase camera keeps the plane centred; altitude 320->332 m and heading 318->316 with a slight bank; f0->f1 shows a camera settle with 23-27k pixels changing in rows 2-3.
entries.defect: Initial camera settle.
entries.fix: Warm up the camera smoothing before capture.

entries.evidence: Lit skyline, container port with cranes and a cruise ship, suburbs and islands are present; the bay has one boat, the bridge and port are unlit, there are no street lights and no traffic.
entries.defect: Night world lacks light sources outside the towers.
entries.fix: Add street lamps, bridge lights, port floodlights and lit boats.

entries.evidence: Near islands are individual blobs while far suburbs are single-pixel speckle; window lights are the same pixel size regardless of distance; the port is sharp while adjacent low-rise is noise.
entries.defect: LOD and light scale do not follow distance.
entries.fix: Scale emissive point size with distance and fade far speckle into haze.

entries.evidence: Every tower uses the same random window-dot pattern, the canopy is one cloned blob and the container stacks tile the same colour pattern; no evenly spaced rows were found above the horizon in this view.
entries.defect: Cloned canopy and repeated window pattern.
entries.fix: Vary window patterns per building and introduce tree variants.

entries.evidence: Bridge cables break into dots, the pink HUD marker sits on the fuselage spine, and broad dark bands cross the water without a visible caster.
entries.defect: Cable aliasing and an unexplained shadow band.
entries.fix: Fix cable rendering and cloud-shadow scale; move the aim marker off the airframe.

entries.evidence: Still HUD 116 kt / 1050 ft / hdg 318 matches telemetry (59.4 m/s, 320 m, 318); during the clip it stays fixed while telemetry moves to 57.9 m/s (113 kt), 332 m (1089 ft), heading 316.
entries.defect: HUD frozen in clip.
entries.fix: Update HUD text every frame.

entries.evidence: 60 frames: f0 40.6 ms, median 17.7 ms (slowest of the 13 views, about double the daytime chase medians), p95 36.8 ms, max 44 ms at frame 15; 3.25 M triangles, 782 calls, heap 212-214 MB.
entries.defect: Consistently slow frames with 40+ ms spikes.
entries.fix: Batch emissive windows into instanced geometry and reduce point-light overdraw.

entries.condition: Fixed three-quarter rear product framing (no objective.json)
entries.evidence: Aircraft centroid (0.50,0.51) with the fuselage filling C4-F7 and the right wing running to x 0.985 at H4 so the wingtip touches the frame edge; tree wall, beach and docks fill rows 1-3 and the sky the top 30 %.
entries.defect: Dead-centre placement with the right wingtip clipped against the frame edge.
entries.fix: Offset the camera so the nose leads into open frame and both wingtips have margin.

entries.condition: Aircraft outline in three-quarter rear view (crops/aircraft.png, crops/medium.png)
entries.evidence: Fuselage taper, high wing, fin with yellow cap, tailplane and twin floats read as a floatplane; the wing is still a constant-chord slab and the fin base carries an odd flat fillet slab.
entries.defect: Slab wing and a flat fillet at the fin base.
entries.fix: Taper the wing and blend the dorsal fillet into the fuselage.

entries.condition: Part connectivity, joins and modelled detail (struts_floats, tail_join, medium crops)
entries.evidence: Float struts form a lattice that meets floats and fuselage at real junctions and water rudders are modelled with yellow tips; the tailplane pierces the fin base with a hard seam and a grey wedge, the wingtip carries a beige panel that reads as a mismatched part, and a flat dark rectangle is stuck under the fuselage.
entries.defect: Hard tail seam and a mismatched wingtip panel.
entries.fix: Rebuild the fin/tailplane junction as one shell and fix the wingtip material assignment.

entries.condition: Aircraft size versus dock posts, sailboats and trees
entries.evidence: Using fin height ~2 m at ~12 m as the scale key, dock posts compute to ~1.7 m and sailboat masts to ~12 m, both plausible; canopy blobs compute to ~35-40 m and read as boulders rather than trees.
entries.defect: Trees oversized relative to the aircraft.
entries.fix: Reduce shoreline tree height to 15-25 m.

entries.evidence: Glossy yellow/white paint shows a real specular highlight along the spine, crisp 'BAHIA VISTA AIR TAXI' and registration decals and a red/blue cheat line; roughness is still uniform per material, the green navigation light is a flat lime disc and struts are a single grey.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness and a flat nav-light disc.
entries.fix: Add a roughness/clearcoat map with panel variation and an emissive lens with bloom for the nav light.

entries.evidence: Windows are transparent with a full instrument panel, seats and frames visible behind them; the glass has a faint uniform tint but no environment reflection or Fresnel edge and the side windows are unframed rectangles.
entries.defect: No reflection or Fresnel on otherwise correct glass.
entries.fix: Add an environment reflection with Fresnel falloff and thin window frames.

entries.evidence: The only building is a white windowless block boathouse at B3 with no door, roof detail or texture.
entries.defect: Placeholder box building.
entries.fix: Replace with a modelled boathouse with roof, doors and signage.

entries.evidence: A straight uniform sand strip meets the water in a hard line with no wet sand, foam or gradient and no dunes or rocks behind it.
entries.defect: Flat straight coastline strip.
entries.fix: Add shoreline undulation, a wet-sand band and scattered rocks.

entries.condition: Water colour and depth near the beach
entries.evidence: Saturated blue with marbled lighter streaks; the same colour runs right up to the sand with no turquoise shallow or visible bottom.
entries.defect: No depth-based colour transition at the shore.
entries.fix: Blend a shallow-water colour ramp from depth near the beach.

entries.condition: Reflections of the aircraft, boats and dock on calm water
entries.evidence: The aircraft sits on calm water with no mirrored image under the fuselage or floats; sailboats and dock posts also show no reflection; the water shows only its own streak pattern.
entries.defect: Missing reflections directly under a floating aircraft.
entries.fix: Add planar reflections for the water surface, at least for the aircraft and dock.

entries.evidence: Each float is outlined by a uniform soft white halo from bow to stern; at 5 m/s there is no bow wave, no V-wake and no disturbance behind the floats; moored boats have no waterline foam.
entries.defect: Uniform foam ring around the floats instead of a wake.
entries.fix: Replace the halo with a bow-wave and trailing wake driven by speed.

entries.evidence: The tree wall is made of giant low-poly canopy polygons, several of them with black unlit facets, over thin grey post trunks; a few small bushes and one palm break it up; the same blob shapes repeat along the shore.
entries.defect: Cloned giant blobs with black facets.
entries.fix: Fix normals/backfaces on the canopy mesh, reduce tree scale and add species variety.

entries.evidence: Wooden piers with posts that reach the water and rails; construction is plain boxes without planks, cleats or bumpers.
entries.defect: Box-modelled piers.
entries.fix: Add plank texture, cleats and mooring lines.

entries.evidence: Small cumulus puffs with soft edges and brighter tops; few in number and partly hidden behind the HUD at E1; no undersides or depth cues.
entries.defect: Small flat puffs.
entries.fix: Add undersides and larger cloud groups.

entries.evidence: Scene depth is under 200 m so little haze is expected; the sky gradient is present; nothing contradicts distance.
entries.defect: Nothing to test beyond the sky gradient.
entries.fix: None required for this view.

entries.evidence: Bright top-lit airframe with a highlight and well-exposed water; the tree wall shows large black facets that contradict the sunny key light.
entries.defect: Unlit black canopy facets under full sun.
entries.fix: Fix canopy normals and add ambient fill to foliage.

entries.evidence: No aircraft shadow on the water, no strut shadows on the float decks, no boat or dock shadows, no canopy shadows on the beach.
entries.defect: Shadows missing everywhere in a close-up.
entries.fix: Enable shadow maps for the aircraft and shoreline props.

entries.evidence: The fuselage highlight is convincing; the water has no sun glitter and the glass has no reflection; floats show a modest sheen.
entries.defect: Water and glass have no specular.
entries.fix: Add sun glitter to the water and reflections to the glass.

entries.evidence: Saturated tropical palette is consistent across sky, water and livery; black facets and the lime nav light disc stand out.
entries.defect: Isolated outliers rather than a grading problem.
entries.fix: Tone the nav light and fix canopy shading.

entries.condition: Temporal stability under a fixed camera (metrics.flicker, clip diffs)
entries.evidence: Flicker meanAbsDiff 1.99 with max 2.33 is near-uniform; per-frame change concentrates on the moving aircraft and on the tree wall (mean 3.6 luminance/frame in D1-E2) while water changes 0.8, so foliage sways or shimmers under a static camera.
entries.defect: Foliage movement/shimmer.
entries.fix: Check wind animation amplitude and add anti-aliasing to thin trunks and masts.

entries.condition: Taxi physics and fixed camera (clip telemetry)
entries.evidence: Aircraft holds 5 m/s at 0 % throttle and 600 rpm, turns from 240 to 249 deg with no water-rudder deflection and no bobbing or pitch response to the water; the fixed camera is appropriate for the shot.
entries.defect: Sliding without wake, rudder motion or buoyancy response.
entries.fix: Couple hull motion to the water surface and animate water rudders with heading changes.

entries.evidence: Docks, six or seven sailboats, a boathouse and forest are present; no people, cars, signage, buoys or birds; boats are moored with sails hoisted.
entries.defect: Sparse, static shoreline with implausible hoisted sails.
entries.fix: Lower sails on moored boats and add people, gear and buoys.

entries.evidence: The aircraft has decals, instruments and rudders while boats 100 m away are boxy hulls with single-plane sails and the trees are giant polygons; the fidelity gap is visible in one frame.
entries.defect: Hero asset far more detailed than the environment 100 m away.
entries.fix: Raise shoreline prop fidelity or use mid-detail boat and tree models.

entries.evidence: The same sailboat model appears at least five times with identical hoisted sails, dock posts are identical, and canopy blobs repeat along the shore.
entries.defect: Cloned boats and trees.
entries.fix: Add boat variants and tree variety.

entries.evidence: Black unlit facets on the canopy; a yellow propeller-tip square hangs below the nose at F5 on a razor-thin line because the edge-on blade has no thickness; a flat lime nav-light disc; the pink HUD marker on the fuselage; a grey wedge at the fin base.
entries.defect: Paper-thin propeller blade leaving a detached tip square, plus unlit facets.
entries.fix: Give blades real thickness or a blurred disc, fix canopy normals, and move the aim marker off the airframe in fixed views.

entries.evidence: Still HUD 10 kt / 6 ft / hdg 240 matches telemetry (5 m/s, 1.96 m, 240); in the clip the HUD keeps 240 while heading reaches 249 and speed drops to 9 kt.
entries.defect: HUD frozen in clip.
entries.fix: Update HUD every frame.

entries.evidence: f0 11.5 s (shader compile), then median 13.8 ms, p95 25.1 ms, max 32 ms; 3.93 M triangles and 779 calls for a close-up where most of the world is outside the view.
entries.defect: Poor culling keeps the whole world in the draw list.
entries.fix: Frustum/occlusion cull distant districts in close views and precompile shaders.

entries.fix: Add roughness variation and a metallic finish to the struts and spinner.

entries.evidence: Windows are transparent with correct sorting (far shore visible through them), a pilot head with headset, seats and panel inside, and framed windshield panes; glass has a faint tint but no environment reflection or Fresnel edge.
entries.defect: No reflection or Fresnel on the glass.

entries.evidence: A varied skyline with a red/white tower sits at F4-G4 and low blocks line the bridge landing at A4-B4; at ~5 km the buildings read as a city, with simple box massing.

entries.fix: Add roofline variety to the far districts.

entries.fix: Add bays and headlands to the far shore silhouette.

entries.defect: No depth or distance variation in water colour.
entries.fix: Add distance-based colour shift and near-surface transparency.

entries.fix: Add planar reflections for the water surface.

entries.evidence: Only distant palms along the far beach are visible as dots; nothing readable enough to fail or pass.
entries.defect: Insufficient visible vegetation to judge beyond dot palms.
entries.fix: None specific to this view.

entries.evidence: A long causeway with piers reaching the water, cars on the deck and a tower at C3; the tower cables render as scattered dots and the deck is very thin.
entries.defect: Cable aliasing on the tower.
entries.fix: Give cables a minimum screen width.

entries.evidence: Scattered cumulus with soft shading, brighter tops and flat bases spread across the sky in varied sizes.
entries.defect: Clouds are small and lack undersides.
entries.fix: Add undersides and a few larger cloud groups.

entries.evidence: The skyline and bridge fade toward the sky colour with distance; the far water lightens at the horizon.
entries.defect: Slight uniformity in the haze band.
entries.fix: Add mild variation in far haze density.

entries.evidence: Bright sun with paint highlights and a well-exposed sky; the wing casts no shade on the cabin roof and nothing casts shadows, so the key light has no directional consequence.
entries.defect: Lighting without shadowing.
entries.fix: Enable shadow casting from the airframe.

entries.evidence: No aircraft shadow on the water, no wing shadow on the fuselage or cabin, no strut shadows on the floats.
entries.defect: Shadows missing in a close-up.
entries.fix: Enable shadow maps for the aircraft.

entries.evidence: Fuselage and spinner highlights are convincing; the water shows no sun glitter and the glass no reflection.
entries.defect: Water and glass have no specular.
entries.fix: Add sun glitter to the water and reflections to the glass.

entries.evidence: Bright tropical palette consistent across sky, water and livery.
entries.defect: None significant.
entries.fix: None required.

entries.evidence: Flicker meanAbsDiff 2.06 (max 2.90); the propeller strobes between discrete blade positions frame to frame instead of blurring, and tower cables render as toggling dots; water and sky are stable.
entries.defect: Propeller strobing and cable dot shimmer.
entries.fix: Use a blurred prop disc above idle and anti-alias the cables.

entries.condition: Taxi physics and fixed camera (clip telemetry)
entries.evidence: Aircraft holds 5 m/s at 0 % throttle and 600 rpm and yaws 240 to 249 deg with no rudder or water-rudder deflection and no bobbing; the fixed camera is appropriate.
entries.defect: Sliding without buoyancy or control response.
entries.fix: Couple hull motion to the water and animate control surfaces.

entries.evidence: Bridge with traffic, a skyline, two ships and a red/green channel marker give context; the water near the aircraft is empty and there are no birds or nearby boats.
entries.defect: Empty foreground water.
entries.fix: Add a nearby boat or buoy field and birds.

entries.evidence: The hero aircraft is detailed and the environment is 2-5 km away so the fidelity gap is mostly hidden; the bridge deck and ships are simple but plausible at that range.
entries.defect: Gap hidden by distance rather than solved.
entries.fix: None specific to this view.

entries.evidence: Bridge piers are regularly spaced as expected; clouds vary in size; no clone rows or evenly spaced dashes found on the horizon.
entries.defect: None significant.
entries.fix: None required.

entries.evidence: Two yellow propeller-tip squares float beside the nose on hairline blades, the cowl ring has a jagged unfiltered edge, a flat white plate sits under the fuselage and the right wing is cut by the frame edge.
entries.defect: Floating detached tip squares and aliased cowl ring.
entries.fix: Fix blade geometry and enable anti-aliasing on the cowl.

entries.evidence: Still HUD 10 kt / 6 ft / hdg 240 matches telemetry; in the clip the HUD keeps 240 while heading reaches 249 and speed drops to 9 kt.
entries.defect: HUD frozen in clip.
entries.fix: Update HUD every frame.

entries.evidence: f0 3.2 s (shader compile), then median 12.3 ms, p95 21.8 ms, max 28.1 ms; 3.47 M triangles and 760 calls for a close-up.
entries.defect: High triangle count for a close-up.
entries.fix: Cull distant districts in close views.

No reflection or shadow of the floating aircraft (B5-F7)
Uniform white halo around the floats (B6-F7)
best3: Transparent cockpit with pilot and correct sorting (C4-E5)
Glossy livery with rivets and decals (B4-F6)
Bridge piers reach the water with traffic on deck (A4-C4)

entries.condition: Fixed side-on cabin close-up meant to show glazing under sun (no objective.json for this view)
entries.evidence: Camera at 3 m height, fov 32, plane centroid (0.50,0.55); the wing forms a yellow band across row 2 and is cut by both frame edges, the floats are cut by the bottom edge, the fin and tailplane are cut by the right edge, and the wing strut crosses the tail diagonally; the sun itself is out of frame and produces no glint on glass or water; skyline peeks out at F3-H3.
entries.defect: Airframe clipped on three sides and the premise of the shot (sun on glass) is not visible in the frame.
entries.fix: Pull the camera back or swing it so the sun lies behind the glazing at a grazing angle, keep the wing and floats inside the frame, and drop the strut out of the line to the tail.

entries.condition: Side-on outline of the floatplane (roofline crop, tail crop)
entries.evidence: High wing on a single lift strut, cabin with three side windows, twin floats and a strut cage read as a floatplane; the cabin roof is a lumpy pillow surface with irregular bulges, the wing is a constant-section tube-like slab and the fin is a flat plate with a stair-stepped yellow leading edge.
entries.defect: Lumpy roof and slab wing spoil an otherwise readable side profile.
entries.fix: Rebuild the cabin roof as a smooth lofted surface and give the wing an airfoil section with a tapered tip.

entries.condition: Part connectivity and modelled detail (bar_zoom, roofline, medium crops)
entries.evidence: A horizontal strut brace at H2-H3 ends in mid-air with a flat cap and connects to nothing; the roof mesh has irregular bulges above the windows; a dark blue box protrudes through the top of the cowl at A4; the wing lift strut passes in front of the fin; the fin leading edge is a stepped polygon.
entries.defect: Floating strut brace and a lumpy roof mesh.
entries.fix: Attach the brace to the lift strut or delete it; smooth the roof; model the exhaust/step as part of the cowl instead of an intersecting box.

entries.condition: Aircraft size versus pilot head, channel marker and ship
entries.evidence: Pilot head with headset is about 0.6 of the side-window height, consistent with a light-aircraft cabin; the channel marker and the cargo ship at G3 read at a plausible size relative to the airframe.
entries.defect: None measurable from this angle.
entries.fix: Keep.

entries.condition: Aircraft materials at 2 m (crops/aircraft.png, crops/distant.png, crops/environment.png)
entries.evidence: Glossy paint shows a spine highlight, panel lines, rivets and a red/blue cheat line; the 'BAHIA VISTA AIR TAXI' decal is blurred at this range, a plain blue square decal sits at C5, the wing underside is covered in black speckle noise that reads as dirt spots, and the struts and float tops are flat grey-blue with one roughness.
entries.defect: Low-resolution decals and noise speckle at a range where the hero asset is fully inspected.
entries.fix: Use a higher-resolution livery atlas or vector decals, replace the speckle with a proper grime/rivet map, and give struts a metallic roughness variation.

entries.condition: Cockpit glazing at 2 m under a sun-lit sky (glass_wide, glass_panes crops)
entries.evidence: Panes are transparent and correctly sorted (water and far shore visible through them) with bevelled frames; the glass carries one uniform light-blue tint and no reflection of the sky, sun or wing, no Fresnel brightening at grazing angles and no highlight; inside, the pilot is a featureless sphere with a headset, the seats are brown boxes and a tan cylinder stands in the rear cabin.
entries.defect: Glass has zero specular response to the sun in a shot named for it, and the interior is a sphere-and-box placeholder at 1 m.
entries.fix: Add an environment/sun reflection with Fresnel on the glass material and replace the pilot sphere and box seats with modelled meshes.

entries.condition: Distant skyline behind the tail (skyline_far crop)
entries.evidence: Pastel box towers with flat roofs and a few glass slabs read as a distant city and are correctly hazed; no roof plant, setbacks or fine massing; the left shore shows only a low grey deck line.
entries.defect: Simple box massing visible even at distance.
entries.fix: Add roof detail and varied massing to the towers that appear in the skyline band.

entries.evidence: The shore is a ruler-straight line at y 0.255 across the whole width with a thin green strip and no beach, headland or variation in either direction.
entries.defect: Straight far shoreline.
entries.fix: Add coastline undulation and beach/mangrove edge to the far shore mesh.

entries.evidence: Saturated mid-blue water with faint horizontal ripple streaks, paling towards the horizon; no depth-driven colour change near the floats and the bright cyan glow under the aircraft comes from the float halo rather than the water.
entries.defect: No depth variation or subsurface tone in the water colour.
entries.fix: Drive the water albedo from depth and add a subsurface tint near the hull.

entries.condition: Reflections of the aircraft, ship and marker on calm water (floats_water crop)
entries.evidence: The aircraft sits on nearly calm water with no mirrored image under the fuselage, struts or floats; the cargo ship and the channel marker have no reflections; the water shows only its own streak pattern.
entries.defect: Missing reflections directly under a floating aircraft.
entries.fix: Add planar or screen-space reflections for the near water plane and distort them with the normal map.

entries.condition: Wakes and float interaction at 4.7 m/s (floats_water, floats_truss crops)
entries.evidence: Each float is wrapped in a uniform soft white halo from bow to stern with no bow wave, no V-wake and no disturbance trailing behind; the ship on the horizon has no wake.
entries.defect: Uniform foam ring around the floats instead of a wake.
entries.fix: Replace the halo with a bow wave and trailing V-wake driven by float speed; add a wake to moving ships.

entries.condition: Vegetation in the far shore strip (skyline_far, bar_zoom crops)
entries.evidence: Only a dark green strip and a row of dot palms show along the shore behind the tail; too small to judge beyond them being flat dots in a line.
entries.defect: Insufficient visible vegetation beyond dot palms.
entries.fix: Add mid-distance vegetation clusters where the shore is visible.

entries.condition: Bridge towers, channel marker and ship (hud crop, bar_zoom crop)
entries.evidence: Two cable-stayed towers show above the wing as thin grey frames with faint dotted cable fans; the channel marker is a brown post with a green square sign and a white cube on top; the ship is a box hull with a block bridge; the causeway deck is a flat grey line.
entries.defect: Placeholder marker and box ship in the mid-ground.
entries.fix: Model a proper day-mark buoy with a lantern, give the ship a hull profile and deck detail, and thicken the tower cables so they do not alias.

entries.evidence: Small scattered cumulus with bright tops and slightly grey bases; soft edges but little vertical build and no shading gradient across the puff.
entries.defect: Small flat puffs.
entries.fix: Increase cloud vertical extent and add self-shadowing to the undersides.

entries.condition: Atmospheric perspective on the skyline and horizon (skyline_far crop)
entries.evidence: The skyline at several km is lightened and desaturated, the horizon water pales to a milky blue and the transition is smooth; the haze band is a single tone with no variation.
entries.defect: Slight uniformity in the haze band.
entries.fix: Add subtle height and distance variation to the aerial perspective.

entries.condition: Sunlight and exposure in a 'glass-sun' shot
entries.evidence: The airframe is top-lit with a spine highlight and the sky is well exposed; the wing directly above the cabin casts no shade on the roof or fuselage, the strut cage casts nothing on the floats, and the sun produces no glint on glass or water; a faint milky veil flattens contrast across the frame.
entries.defect: Key light has no directional consequence and the sun is never seen in a shot named for it.
entries.fix: Enable shadow casting from the wing and struts and place the sun so its highlight is visible on the glazing.

entries.evidence: No shadow from the wing on the roof or fuselage side, none from the struts on the floats, none inside the cabin; the airframe reads as lit from everywhere.
entries.defect: Shadows missing in a close-up.
entries.fix: Enable shadow maps for the aircraft with contact hardening.

entries.condition: Specular response of glass, paint and water
entries.evidence: Paint and the wing tube carry believable highlights; the glass shows no reflection or Fresnel; the water has no sun glitter; the struts show flat shading.
entries.defect: Glass and water carry no specular in a shot meant to test them.
entries.fix: Add environment reflection and Fresnel to the glass material and sun glitter to the water.

entries.evidence: Saturated yellow/blue livery matches the other aircraft views; a faint milky veil lowers contrast overall; sky and water hues are harmonious.
entries.defect: Slight low-contrast veil.
entries.fix: Lift black point slightly and keep the veil for haze only.

entries.condition: Temporal stability under a fixed camera (metrics.flicker, per-cell clip diffs)
entries.evidence: Flicker meanAbsDiff 4.54 (max 7.0) is the highest of the aircraft close-ups, but per-cell diffs concentrate on the drifting aircraft (glass 10-15, floats 10-12 luminance/frame) while the sky stays at 0.2-0.3; thin struts and the dotted tower cables crawl as the plane moves.
entries.defect: Edge crawl on struts and cable dots during drift.
entries.fix: Add temporal or MSAA anti-aliasing and thicken the tower cables.

entries.condition: Taxi physics and fixed camera (clip telemetry)
entries.evidence: Aircraft holds 4.7 m/s at 0 % throttle and 600 rpm and yaws from 240 to 249 deg with no water-rudder deflection and no bobbing or pitch; the fixed camera is appropriate for the shot.
entries.defect: Sliding without buoyancy or control response.
entries.fix: Add buoyancy oscillation and rudder deflection to the taxi state.

entries.evidence: Behind the aircraft there is a lone cargo ship, a single channel marker and a distant skyline; the near water is empty, no other boats, birds or shore activity appear in a harbour-side scene.
entries.defect: Empty foreground water and a lone lollipop marker.
entries.fix: Populate the channel with moored boats, buoys and shore detail.

entries.evidence: Rivets, decals and bevelled window frames at 2 m sit against a three-primitive channel marker and a box ship at a few hundred metres and box towers beyond.
entries.defect: Hero asset far more detailed than mid-distance props.
entries.fix: Raise the detail of mid-distance props to match the hero LOD.

entries.evidence: Identical dot palms in a line along the far shore and identical brown box seats in the cabin; skyline colours are varied and no cloned buildings are evident.
entries.defect: Evenly spaced dot palms on the shore.
entries.fix: Jitter palm placement and vary cabin seat models.

entries.evidence: The cheat-line boundary at the nose breaks into a jagged saw-tooth comb where the stripe texture smears; a strut brace floats detached at H2-H3; a dark blue box intersects the cowl at A4; tower cables render as dotted lines; HUD boxes overlap the wing.
entries.defect: Floating geometry plus texture-comb aliasing on the livery.
entries.fix: Fix the livery UV seam around the nose, remove or attach the loose brace, and merge the cowl box.

entries.evidence: Still HUD 10 kt / 6 ft / hdg 240 matches telemetry (5 m/s, 1.96 m, 240); in the clip the HUD keeps 240 while heading reaches 249 and speed drops to 9 kt.
entries.defect: HUD frozen in clip.
entries.fix: Bind HUD fields to live telemetry each frame.

entries.evidence: f0 6.0 s (shader compile), then median 12.2 ms, p95 24.5 ms, max 44.6 ms with a spike at f9; 2.99 M triangles and 667 calls in the clip, 3.53 M and 843 for the still, in a close-up where most of the world is off-screen; heap flat at 212-213 MB.
entries.defect: Poor culling and spiky frame times for a close-up.
entries.fix: Frustum-cull the city and bridge when the camera is at the waterline and tighten LOD ranges.
